claims.disproof_condition: 條件：ASMPT 後續業績公告或年報寫出打線機需求轉弱、主流業務回落，或把打線機的成長改寫成與 AI 無關（只有消費性、國產替代）；或客戶端一手（封測廠、IDM）寫出 AI 電源或 AI 基建的封裝不用打線。核查頻率：每季（ASMPT 季度業績與中期／年度報告）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 的 claim 降 confidence、重讀打線層（tech:wire_bonding）與 K&S 敘事「需求」那一格。
claims.statement: ASMPT's own 2026 interim results announcement (HKEX, six months to 30 June 2026): its SEMI mainstream business sells wire bonding (WB) and die bonding (DB) tools; China revenue and bookings were especially strong, with WB/DB tool demand 'supported by ongoing AI infrastructure expansion and high OSAT utilisation', while IDM utilisation rose on power-management demand for AI data centres. Q2 SEMI growth in wire and die bonders was attributed to 'both AI and consumer related applications'; Q2 SEMI bookings rose 125.9% YoY on wire and die bonders, Photonics and TCB; China's revenue share rose from 38.1% to 42.2% mainly on wire and die bonders. Supplier self-report: no wire-bonder-only revenue, unit volume, lead time, allocation or named customer; the AI attribution is the supplier's own characterisation of its market.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：ASMPT 後續業績公告或年報寫出先進封裝／TCB 營收轉為年減、TCB 訂單取消或客戶改用他家（BESI、Hanmi、K&S 等）。核查頻率：每季（ASMPT 季度業績、中期與年報）。觸發後 48 小時：e2 的 claim 降 confidence，重讀先進封裝層讀圖的供給側。
claims.statement: ASMPT's own 2026 interim results announcement (HKEX, 2026-07-28): its Advanced Packaging (AP) solutions include Thermo Compression Bonding (TCB) and Hybrid Bonding, Photonics, high-precision Flip Chip and Mass Reflow, and advanced SMT placement tools for AI server boards; AP revenue was a record US$339.0 million in 1H 2026 (+17% YoY, 30% of Group revenue), with TCB, SMT high precision and Photonics the largest contributors; in logic, chip-to-substrate TCB had repeat orders from OSAT partners of 'the leading advanced logic customer' and new bulk orders for more than 50 C2S TCB tools in July 2026; in memory it continued to secure repeat orders from HBM manufacturers, with timing dependent on HBM4 rollout. Supplier self-report (single origin, L8 weak): customers are unnamed; no TCB-only revenue, lead time or allocation. Mirrors the K&S seat on this layer ([749]); no edge to HBM is claimed.

source_doc.title: ASMPT Limited Announcement Of 2026 Unaudited Interim Results（六個月至 2026-06-30）節錄：SEMI 主流業務、打線與黏晶機需求；先進封裝（TCB）

sources.quote: ASMPT Limited and its subsidiaries (the “Group” or “ASMPT”) delivered revenue from Continuing operations of HK$8.90 billion (US$1.14 billion) for the six months ended 30 June 2026

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — SEMI Mainstream
sources.quote: SEMI mainstream business experienced significant growth, supported by high utilisation at leading IDMs due to improving demand for power management requirements for AI data centres, and industrial applications. Notably, China’s revenue and bookings were especially strong, with wire bonding (“WB”) and die bonding (“DB”) tool demand supported by ongoing AI infrastructure expansion and high OSAT utilisation.

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — SEMI Q2 revenue
sources.quote: QoQ and YoY growth were driven by Photonics due to AI-related applications, and wire and die bonders due to both AI and consumer related applications.

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — SEMI Q2 bookings
sources.quote: SEMI Q2 bookings of HK$3.36 billion (US$428.1 million) were up 39.0% QoQ due to wire and die bonders and Photonics, and up 125.9% YoY due to wire and die bonders, Photonics and TCB.

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — 地區
sources.quote: By geography, share of revenue from China increased to from 38.1% in 1H 2025 to 42.2% YoY in 1H 2026 mainly driven by wire and die bonders

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — Advanced Packaging 產品組合
sources.quote: AP solutions include Thermo Compression Bonding (“TCB”) and Hybrid Bonding for system-level integration, Photonics for high-speed data movement, high- precision Flip Chip and Mass Reflow for cost-efficient scaling, and advanced SMT placement tools for AI server boards.

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — Advanced Packaging 營收
sources.quote: The AP business achieved record half-year revenue of US$339.0 million in 1H 2026, representing a 17% YoY increase and contributing to 30% of Group revenue. TCB, SMT high precision and Photonics solutions were the largest contributors within the AP portfolio.

sources.locator: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS — TCB（logic, C2S）
sources.quote: In logic, order momentum for the Group’s chip-to-substrate (“C2S”) solutions remained strong, supported by repeat orders for larger compound die TCB tools from OSAT partners of the leading advanced logic customer. In July 2026, the Group received new bulk orders for more than 50 of its C2S TCB tools from OSAT customers.
In memory, even as the Group continued to secure repeat orders from HBM manufacturers, the timing of customers’ new tool purchase decisions remains dependent on HBM4 product rollout schedules.
